The turn-transition code in `advance_step` (when cleanup → untap) never copies `spells_cast_this_turn` → `spells_cast_last_turn`. Both fields are initialized to empty `HashMap::new()` and stay that way for the entire game.

**Practical consequence:**
- `total_spells_last_turn` (sum over empty map) is always 0 → Villagers of Estwald always transforms at every upkeep after turn 1, regardless of whether any spells were cast
- `values().any(|&count| count >= 2)` over an empty map is always false → Howlpack of Estwald never transforms back, even after two or more spells were cast

All werewolf tests bypass this by manually writing `state.spells_cast_last_turn.insert(P0, N)` in test setup, so tests pass despite the broken engine.

### Secondary issue: wrong log message on back-transform

`villagers_of_estwald.rs` line 88: when Howlpack transforms back, the hardcoded string `"Villagers of Estwald"` is the source name in the log, producing `"Villagers of Estwald transforms into Villagers of Estwald"` instead of `"Howlpack of Estwald transforms into Villagers of Estwald"`.
